key_concepts: Matter exists as solid, liquid, or gas
Phase change is a change of state without changing chemical composition
Melting is the change from solid to liquid
Freezing or solidification is the change from liquid to solid
Evaporation is the change from liquid to gas
Condensation is the change from gas to liquid
Sublimation is the change from solid directly to gas
Deposition is the change from gas directly to solid
Increasing temperature increases particle kinetic energy and particle separation
Decreasing temperature decreases particle kinetic energy and brings particles closer
Particle arrangement differs by state: solids very close, liquids close, gases far
Examples include ice melting, drying wet clothes, cloud formation, and dry ice sublimation
